purpose: Scoped IAM user for provisioning/managing the EC2 Production Simulator instance (docs/19-aws-strategy.md Phase 3). Deliberately NOT the account's AdministratorAccess user -- least-privilege per docs/24-aws-prerequisites-setup-guide.md Phase 1 intent, limited to EC2 actions only (no IAM, S3, RDS, or billing access).
note: Access keys for this user live only in the local ~/.aws/credentials [ic-ec2] profile -- never committed. This file intentionally contains no secrets.
